text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see... An Umamusume family shares and 
passes down its wealth and knowledge. To 
understand the essence of that strength—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Interviewing Daiichi Ruby from the 
"Splendid Clan"! According to her, she and 
the clan are always the same... completely 
unified as one, she says.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
With their incredible solidarity, backed 
by knowledge and financial power, it's 
only natural they're strong—but I refuse 
to accept a world where only the winners 
get to win!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Bonds can be forged with people outside 
your family too! Trainer and I will show 
everyone what's possible!
